correctness.rationale: Strict spectral-trace convexity and an injective edge-Laplacian map force unique unrestricted edge weights. Cyclic symmetry gives two orbits without assuming invariance. The exact Fourier spectrum yields the one-sided price condition with correct p=0 normalization and budget. Equality forces zero rung via strict convexity, and a=0 is disconnected. Rational c0/c1 values follow from csc^2 and csc^4 sums. For fixed p, dominated endpoint sums for T and integrable/logarithmic/zeta regimes for S prove the n^(2p+1), n^2/log n, and n^2 scales. Actual verify.py passed 15,506 finite assertions, including exact Fraction pseudoinverses; those checks are not the proof.

value.rationale: The optimal inclusion/exclusion of a complete antipodal matching under a real cost has direct relevance to sparse conductance budgets; an explicit threshold eliminates repeated optimization for each graph size. The fixed-order price frontier changes exponent at the exact half-order boundary with an explicit logarithmic critical coefficient, and c1 has a new simple rational expression. This is a motivated all-size structural allocation and asymptotic classification, not an arbitrary finite slice or merely the known determinant case.
